create.name: Deva Munay
create.bio:
Deva Munay is a sound practitioner and musician who lives in Big Sur, California, where in 2018 she opened Sacred Sound & Wonder, a studio in an old art barn on K Paradise Ranch above the Pacific. Her interest in sacred sound goes back to the late 1990s, when she sat in on the Dalai Lama's teachings in northern India and was given her first instruments. Long journeys followed through Nepal, Thailand, Peru, Egypt, Bali and Central America. She has university degrees in biology, cultural anthropology, art and sound therapy, along with yoga and massage training.

Her main instruments are alchemy crystal singing bowls, which she plays alongside chimes, rattles and her own voice, and she draws on the Nada Yoga view of sound as a path to the sacred. Sessions are largely lying-down sound journeys for rest and deep listening, given one to one at her studio or over Zoom, and in community evenings around Big Sur and Carmel. She leads week-long retreats at Esalen, small group trips to swim near humpback whales off Mo'orea in French Polynesia, and online courses. On record she has worked with Peter Gordon as Lifting the Sky and with Edwin Huizinga and Penny Vieregge on settings of the poems of Hafiz.

videos.title: A Chakras & Healing Sound Bowl Journey with Deva Munay

courses.title: The Resonant Heart: Sound Journeys for Love and Renewal
courses.description: A five-day midwinter retreat at Esalen in Big Sur, timed for the new moon and Imbolc. It includes seven crystal bowl sound journeys, breath and gentle movement, time in the Art Barn and walks on the land.

courses.title: The Living Pattern of Light: Alchemy Sound Journeys for Peace and Illumination
courses.description: A five-day Esalen retreat starting on Memorial Day, built around seven crystal bowl journeys that move through the chakras. Guests also try playing the bowls, add to a shared Flower of Life mandala and hear Hafiz read by the Big Sur poet Damaris.

courses.title: Sound Alchemy Session in Big Sur
courses.description: A private sound journey at her studio on the Big Sur coast for one or two people, lying down while she plays crystal bowls, chimes and rattles. An hour or 90 minutes, with a fee for each extra guest.

courses.title: Virtual Alchemy Sound Sessions
courses.description: One-to-one sound sessions and conversation over Zoom, booked as single hours or as three- and six-month series meeting twice a month. Online bowl consultations are booked from the same page.

courses.title: Whale Song Pilgrimage to Mo'orea
courses.description: An eight-day small-group trip to Mo'orea in French Polynesia with four days on the water, swimming near humpback whales with local guides. Sound, quiet time and attention to moon and tides fill the rest of the week; 2027 dates are not yet published.

free_resources.title: The Sacred Sound Library
free_resources.description: Hour-long recordings of her seasonal and full moon sound journeys from Big Sur, free to listen to with an optional donation. Newsletter subscribers are also invited to live online journeys.

flags: Her home page and course pages describe sound as vibrational medicine that soothes the nervous system and balances brainwaves; no condition is named, so she is kept, but item descriptions avoid those claims.
Her About page says she worked with ayahuasca and huachuma in Peru before turning to sound; left out of the bio, and none of her offerings involve plant medicine.
Only one video: her own channel has one undescribed livestream, and a third-party video titled for depression treatment was left out; the one kept is on Esalen's channel.
Two Esalen programmes are listed; the second's URL slug (a-solstice-ritual-…) differs from its current title, The Living Pattern of Light.
